d.title: Ningen Shikkaku: Director's Cut-ban
d.jp: 人間失格 ディレクターズカット版
d.synopsis: A compilation film of four episodes of the Madhouse Aoi Bungaku Series anime, adapting Osamu Dazai's classic literary novel, No Longer Human. The film follows the story of Yozo Oba, a troubled man who is isolated, pretends to be cheerful, and descends into alcoholism and drug abuse.
